action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Normalize weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=np.float64)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_weights = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if sum_weights <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Weight sum is non-positive; future_horizon may be too small")
    weights = raw_weights / sum_weights

    # Compute weighted future-token loss for each candidate (T02)
    # logp matrices are log probabilities, losses are negative weighted log prob
    def weighted_loss(logp_mat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return -np.dot(logp_mat, weights)  # shape (n_candidates,)

    L_with_result = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)  # L_plus
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Margin and threshold (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
